memo.headline: Prioritize billing_support: revisit and measure the free-tier control paywall, the largest and fastest-rising chronic complaint driver.
memo.memo_markdown:
## Recommendation

Put next quarter (starting after Nov 2023) into **billing_support**, centered on one issue: basic playback controls locked behind premium (billing.premium_only_controls). This is a product/pricing-decision wave on top of a chronic base, so the effort is to revisit, mitigate and measure the change, not to wait it out.

## Evidence

- **Volume and severity:** billing.premium_only_controls ranks #2 overall with 9415 complaints [C1], severity sum 26630 [C2], mean severity 2.828465 [C3]. Rank #1, generic negative sentiment (19032 complaints, severity sum 37607 [C4]), has no specifics, so there is nothing actionable to build against.
- **Persistence:** it is present in all 17 full months and flagged chronic, not purely episodic. First-6-month mean share was 1.61% versus 7.92% for the last 6, and the trend is rising.
- **Direction of travel:** billing_support complaints rose from 1336 in 2023-09 to 5535 in 2023-10, then 1510 in 2023-11 (partial month). In the comparable windows its share of classified reviews went from 3.02% (H2-2022) to 12.10% (mid-2023). Anomalies in 2023-09 and 2023-10 name this issue as top driver. They coincide with a lyrics paywall test and free-tier restrictions in India, which is context, not proven cause.
- **Cancellation language:** it leads the cancellation ranking, with 2049 cancellation-intent reviews. This is expressed intent, not observed churn.
- **Representative reviews:** (review 8feb3a4c-6984-4b24-8c89-934aced41635) and (review 7e801961-bd6e-4a4c-af91-2068b0e2f173) describe repeat and ordered play now requiring payment; (review 64329ea9-d8dd-4b14-9196-ad96b5a41603) says almost every basic feature requires premium.

## Proposed effort

1. Revisit which controls (repeat, ordered play, rewind) sit behind the paywall, and test less restrictive free-tier variants.
2. Measure the effect with in-product metrics beyond reviews, since reviews cannot show revenue or churn.
3. Fix adjacent usability.controls issues, which are rising and peaked in 2023-10 (1988 complaints [C5]).

## Alternatives compared

- **Usability:** the largest area by complaints (18178; 26.6% of all complaints), but mean severity is low at 2.353229. Ads are chronic and steady [C6]. Redesign complaints spiked in 2023-03 (coinciding with the home feed redesign announcement) but are partly episodic and falling back from that peak; the trend is rising overall, and 2023-10 showed a new rise. Second choice.
- **Playback:** highest severity among large areas (mean 3.136271) and the most severity-4+ records (2716). However, crashes are falling and stops/skips steady [C7]. Maintain, do not lead.
- **Access:** smallest volume (3.4% of complaints) but the most severe (mean 3.808811). Login failure is rising (1558 complaints, mean severity 3.897946 [C8]) and tops the severity-4+ ranking. A strong targeted fix, but low reach.

## Chronic versus event-driven

Chronic: paywalled controls, ads, redesign complaints, stops/skips, shuffle, crashes (falling), controls, login failure. Episodic: lyrics. Event-driven: the 2023-07 volume spike and boycott content coincide with news about Sweden; this is unrelated to product quality and should be discounted.

## Limitations

See the limitations list.

recommendations.title: Address controls removal alongside paywall work

alternatives.assessment: Largest volume but low severity; ads steady, redesign wave partly episodic. Second choice.
High severity, but crashes falling and stops/skips steady; maintain.

limitations: Self-selected public reviews from a historical window ending Nov 2023 (partial first and last months); no revenue, plan tier, churn or population totals.
Cancellation language is intent, not observed churn; no revenue-at-risk estimate is made.
Scope: 150013 records, 149996 completed, 17 quarantined; 15618 flagged needs-review. Many records are unclassified or in other, outside the four areas.
Spikes in 2023-07 and 2023-10 reflect self-selected volume; events are context, not proven causes.
